query:
SELECT COUNT(*)
                    FROM (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM market_data.historical_options_data
                        WHERE stock = $2
                            AND primary_exchange = $3
                            AND currency = $4
                            AND expiry = $5
                            AND strike = $6
                            AND multiplier = $7
                            AND option_type = $8
                            AND time > $9
                        LIMIT $1
                    ) sub;
